changes.reason: New (meshTerm 2.3.1, Agents setup on Windows hosts, docs/windows-signin-and-shell-plan.md 4.2): the official Claude Code installer for a Windows OpenSSH host, in PowerShell 5.1 (the app runs it through its streamed Windows install wrapper). curl.exe downloads https://claude.ai/install.ps1 to the user's own %TEMP% (3 tries; it must start param( as the vendor script does), runs it with -File under a process-scoped Bypass, removes it, exits with its code. Per user (claude.exe install puts the launcher in the profile and the user PATH), no administrator. The family is windows only, and an any (POSIX) line never applies to a windows host. CI skip: not in the Linux container matrix; the gate is James's in-app install test from a TestFlight build carrying this file as a draft.

New (meshTerm 2.3.1, Agents setup on Windows hosts): the official Codex installer for a Windows OpenSSH host. curl.exe downloads https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.ps1 to the user's own %TEMP% (3 tries; it must start [CmdletBinding), and it runs only when Get-AuthenticodeSignature says Valid AND the signer is OpenAI OpCo, LLC (measured on the meshTerm Windows box 2026-10-15; a tampered copy reads NotSigned). CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 keeps the installer's prompts off, as the POSIX line does. Per user, no administrator. The family is windows only, and an any (POSIX) line never applies to a windows host. CI skip: not in the Linux container matrix; the gate is James's in-app install test from a TestFlight build carrying this file as a draft.

New (meshTerm 2.3.1, Agents setup on Windows hosts): the official Antigravity CLI installer for a Windows OpenSSH host. curl.exe downloads https://antigravity.google/cli/install.ps1 to the user's own %TEMP% (3 tries; it must start $ErrorActionPreference as the vendor script does), runs it with -File, removes it, exits with its code. Per user (%LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin), no administrator; the script checks the binary's SHA-512 itself. The family is windows only, and an any (POSIX) line never applies to a windows host. CI skip: not in the Linux container matrix; the gate is James's in-app install test from a TestFlight build carrying this file as a draft.
